items: Using technology: operating computers, tablets and phones; a student uses a word processor to type and format a report.
Searching for information: entering relevant keywords and refining results; a farmer in Punjab searches 'modern irrigation techniques for wheat'.
Evaluating sources: checking who created content and whether the source is trustworthy; a teacher in Lahore checks that a website is run by an educational institution.
Creating digital content: making articles, presentations or edited photos; a student in Karachi builds a PowerPoint presentation.
Online safety and privacy: strong passwords, privacy settings and avoiding suspicious links; a person in Islamabad limits who sees their social-media details.
